notes: InfiniteMoneyGlitch is a fixed-supply ERC-20 with 18 decimals. Its zero-argument constructor mints all 1,000,000,000 IMB to msg.sender once. No application contracts or initialization calls are required. With native ETH as currency0 and IMB as currency1, initialPrice records sqrt(totalSupply / initialMarketCapWei) * 2^96. This value is provenance only; the deployer derives the opening price from the economics and total supply.
